يختصرون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَصِرُونَ (yaḵtaṣirūna) /jax.ta.sˤi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# يُخْتَصَرُونَ (yuḵtaṣarūna) /jux.ta.sˤa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
